name: Gray-Scott Lineages: two species
description: Spots carry their own feed and kill (traits P_F, P_k, shown as tint) and pass them on when they split. Left half painted species A (F 0.0367, k 0.0649), right half species B (F 0.030, k 0.062): spots born on each side keep their side's traits wherever they spread. B replicates faster and colonises A's side; where lineages meet, touching spots slowly blend into a hybrid zone. Try: paint a patch with new F/k (Background target off, brush on) to found a new lineage there; seed into the other species' territory.
